title: Project Context Snapshot
description: 60-second orientation artifact for fresh agents (charter primitive: context recovery). Single file a new agent can read to learn project identity, current milestone state, what's in flight, what the non-goals are, and where to read more. Mostly derived from git, CHARTER.md, docs/roadmap.md, the worker queue, and trust policy; the one operator-maintained field (next_safe_action) is sourced from core/context-pinned.json. Regenerated by scripts/context.sh --write. Doctor (M7.1+) compares source_head_sha against the current HEAD to detect staleness.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant when the snapshot was generated.

source_head_sha.description: git rev-parse HEAD at generation time, or null if not in a git repo. M7.1 doctor compares against current HEAD to detect staleness.

non_goals.description: Verbatim bullets parsed from CHARTER.md's Non-Goals section. Quoted, not summarized.

recent_activity.description: Last N commits with milestone-tag and primitive inferred from the subject. Inference is best-effort; commits without an M-tag report milestone=null/primitive=null.

next_safe_action.description: Operator-maintained one-liner: the single action a fresh agent could safely take right now without re-asking. Sourced from core/context-pinned.json; empty string if unpinned.

charter_one_line.description: First non-empty line of CHARTER.md's Primary Goal section.

last_completed.description: Highest M-tag found in git log subjects (e.g. 'M6.2'). null if no tagged commits.

last_completed_primitive.description: Charter primitive inferred from milestone-major mapping (e.g. M6 -> 'context recovery'). null if not inferrable.

milestone_rule.description: Short summary of the charter milestone rule, glossed for snapshot brevity.

NextMajorMilestone.description: Next *major* roadmap milestone (e.g. M8) beyond the last completed's major. By design the roadmap tracks majors only; the operator's slice-level intent for the immediate next step lives in next_safe_action (sourced from core/context-pinned.json). M7.0 originally named this 'next_proposed' and elided that distinction, which made the snapshot lie when work was in the middle of a major (e.g. after M7.0 it pointed to M8 while the actual next step was M7.1). M7.0.1 renamed the field to make the semantics honest.

present.description: True if a later major was found in docs/roadmap.md.

queue_present.description: False if ~/.cache/agent-continuity/queue/ does not exist on this host.

queue_counts.description: Count per state directory. Keys are state names (queued, claimed, running, awaiting-approval, completed, rejected, failed, cancelled); values are non-negative integers. Schema does not pin keys so new states added in _worker.py do not require schema bumps.

open_tasks.description: Task IDs (filename stems) per open state. Keys are state names from OPEN_STATES; values are arrays of task-id strings. Terminal states (completed/rejected/failed/cancelled) are not listed here.

default_policy_summary.description: Human-readable one-line gloss of the default policy (e.g. 'default denies all', 'default allows 2 kind(s): code-write, read-only').

soonest_expiry.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the earliest-expiring grant, or null if no grant has expires_at.

milestone.description: Inferred M-tag (e.g. 'M6.2') or null if the subject has no recognizable tag.

primitive.description: Charter primitive inferred from the milestone major, or null.
